title: NATS connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One NATS instance's settings (CN2 Task 18, loams_connector_brokers::nats): JetStream durable pull consumers and Nats-Msg-Id publishes by default, or core NATS subjects (`mode: core`, not resumable, at most once).

servers.description: nats://host:4222 or tls://host:4222, without credentials. Servers the cluster advertises are ignored, so egress stays checked.

auth.description: Credentials by secret name: an nkey seed (`key`) or a user credentials file's contents (`jwt`).

nkey_seed.description: An nkey seed. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

credentials.description: A user credentials (.creds) file's contents: the user JWT and its nkey seed. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

tls.description: TLS settings: a CA bundle to trust instead of the webpki roots, and a client certificate for mTLS.

cert_pem.description: PEM client certificate chain for mTLS (not a secret).

key_pem.description: The client's PEM private key, for mTLS. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

mode.description: jetstream (a durable pull consumer, resumable) or core (subscriptions, not resumable).

durable.description: JetStream: the durable consumer; loams-<instance> by default.

ack_wait_s.description: JetStream: seconds before an unacknowledged message is redelivered.

max_ack_pending.description: JetStream: max_ack_pending; by default the pipeline's in-flight budget.

subjects.description: Core: subjects to subscribe to; one split each.

max_batch.description: Messages per batch at most (the pipeline's budget may be smaller).

poll_wait_ms.description: How long one read waits for the first message before reporting nothing.

mode.description: jetstream (publish acks, Nats-Msg-Id = the event id: effectively once within the stream's duplicate window) or core (at most once).

subject.description: A fixed subject; without it, the event's subject.

ack_timeout_ms.description: How long a batch waits for its publish acks.

pipeline.description: The SDK's per-instance pipeline overrides (`PipelineConfig::with_overrides`): max_batch_rows, max_batch_bytes, linger_ms, max_in_flight_batches, memory_budget_bytes, checkpoint_interval_ms and retry. The broker-side window (prefetch, credit, Receive Maximum, max_ack_pending, receiver queue) is derived from them unless set.
